section_slope_factor.source: FD-01: Helmbold/DATCOM section slope factor kappa for a thin reflexed foam section (fleet practice, TT-07)

control_efficiency.source: FD-01: thin-airfoil flap effectiveness correction for taped foam elevon hinges (fleet practice, TT-07)

wing_zero_lift_angle.source: FD-01: reflexed speed section (near-symmetric camber, MH-45/Eppler-reflex class about -0.5 deg); unmeasured

wing_section_moment.source: FD-01: reflexed flying-wing section moment about its aerodynamic centre (slightly positive, MH-45 class); unmeasured

washout_deg.source: FD-01: geometric washout root to tip of a fast flying wing (typical 1-3 deg); applied as zero-mean strip incidence

fuselage_munk_factor.source: FD-01: Gilruth/Munk fuselage pitch destabilisation factor Kf (0.0105 per deg for a centre body whose wing root sits near 45 % of its length), per radian

fuselage_yaw_factor.source: FD-01: DATCOM body yaw destabilisation K_N·K_Rl for a slim centre body, per radian; unmeasured

fin_endplate_factor.source: FD-01: the wing surface end-plates each fin's root (image effect) on its geometric aspect ratio

fin_pressure_ratio.source: FD-01: fin dynamic-pressure/sidewash ratio; fins outside the pusher slipstream

skin_drag_coefficient.source: FD-01: skin/form drag coefficient of a smooth thin foam speed wing and slim body at RC Reynolds number; provisional build-up

excrescence_drag_area.source: FD-01: camera, canopy step, servo horns, motor and hinge-line drag area; provisional

span_efficiency.source: FD-01: Oswald efficiency of a swept tapered flying wing with washout

minimum_drag_lift.source: FD-01: near-symmetric reflexed section minimum-drag lift coefficient

control_drag_elevon.source: FD-01: elevon deflection drag per radian (as the X8 estimate)

control_drag_roll.source: FD-01: antisymmetric elevon drag per radian per surface (as the X8 estimate)

adverse_yaw_factor.source: FD-01: differential profile/induced elevon adverse-yaw estimate (fleet practice)

CL_max.source: FD-01: clean reflexed swept flying wing peak lift, no flaps; unmeasured

CL_min.source: FD-01: inverted peak lift of a near-symmetric reflexed section; unmeasured

stall_blend_width.source: FD-01: attached-to-flat-plate stall blending width (X8 value)

attached_limit.source: FD-01: local attached flow/oracle boundary, established solver domain

tail_local_limit.source: FD-01: fin attached flow angle limit; provisional

tail_stall_end.source: FD-01: fin flat-plate transition end; provisional

tail_CD0.source: FD-01: fin profile drag coefficient; provisional

tail_k.source: FD-01: fin induced drag coefficient; provisional

crossflow_drag.source: FD-01: body crossflow drag coefficient (Allen-Perkins, as the X8)

crossflow_efficiency.source: FD-01: finite-length crossflow efficiency eta for a slender body (as the X8)

motor_resistance.source: FD-01: equivalent winding resistance of a 35-mm 1800 Kv-class outrunner (catalogue range 0.02-0.045 ohm); not measured

motor_no_load_current.source: FD-01: no-load current of a 35-mm 1800 Kv-class outrunner near 10 V; not measured

bus_voltage.source: FD-01: 4S nominal fixed bus (ideal-bus configuration); no sag or depletion

winding_temperature.source: FD-01: context only; no thermal model

rotor_inertia.source: FD-01: 7x6 pusher propeller, adapter and 35-mm outrunner bell; not measured

servo_full_throw_time.source: FD-01: 9 g digital servo class (about 0.10 s/60 deg) turning the estimated elevon travel; not measured

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian of the elevons' symmetric part (δel+δer)/2, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian of each elevon's antisymmetric part, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: none: fixed fins, every rudder term is 0
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point
